comment?:

Then remove `| undefined`
It's logically the same

Where are the standardized headers? Body should be json compliant. 
 This needs to be used across all plugins for a single parser to work

Yes

No. 
However we need to be able to exclude word count from `blockquote` and `code`.

Default to `true` 
The only ones that don't count words are `code` and `blockquote`

We are currently only using it for word counting which I kind of hate. We should hardcode a word counter config property and then under the hood it just uses this regex. 
The repeated regex declarations in our configs looks bad and can be easily replaced with something like "word counter"
Can handle in a new pull but basically I'm suggesting to hard code this regex in place of a new config property so the config looks prettier.

The permit link doesn't work. 
Also I realize that most defaults should be set to 0 probably. It seems like your default scores are very high. 
Off hand what I recall from version one:
$5: img, code, a
$1: ol, ul, h1-6
$0.5: li
$0.1: word counter,
$0: blockquote, bold 
Please fix defaults and ensure permit links are working
We should throw an error for this instead of generating a fake link.
